name: snow-docs
tagline_zh: 写代码的顺手工具：snow-docs。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Use when the user asks to install, configure, troubleshoot, or understand Snow CLI itself — Profile/API setup, MCP servers, Skills, Hooks, sub-agents, sensitive commands, proxy/browser, third-party relay, LSP/ACE, Team mode, SSE, privacy, plugins, or docs paths. Loads official bundled usage docs via progressive disclosure (list/search/get) instead of guessing from model memory.
